portfolio.title: Memory Bubble
portfolio.description: I designed a visually engaging web application focused on guessing numbers or words, offering a dynamic blend of cognitive challenge and social competition. Minimalist UI: Clarity and seamless interaction are prioritized, featuring a vibrant yet restrained purple color palette (#5D58AB) that evokes creativity and energy. Typography: The dynamic Handjet font enhances the app's playful tone while improving readability and immersion in the gameplay.

portfolio.title: Procedural City & Oasis Asset
portfolio.description: The website is designed to make customer bookings quick and easy, providing services faster and more conveniently. With the help of quick booking buttons and animations, the site offers an engaging and lively experience for users. The choice to feature the hands of a senior woman with vibrant red nail polish is both intentional and symbolic. Her wrinkled hands reflect the passage of time, conveying a sense of wisdom and authenticity. In contrast, the bright red polish symbolizes energy, elegance, and a celebration of beauty at any age.

portfolio.title: Minimalist One-Page Portfolio
portfolio.description: Recently, I designed a minimalist one-page portfolio for a client, focusing on simplicity and impact. The goal was to present their skills and work clearly, using clean design and a limited color palette. 🔍 Why Minimalism? - Clarity: Keeps the focus on what matters most. - Efficiency: Quick to load, easy to navigate. - Professional Look: Simple, yet powerful. portfolio.title: Try Harder
portfolio.description: I designed the UI/UX and created all in-game icons using Aseprite, focusing on clarity, consistency, and personality. Every element—from menus to micro-interactions—was crafted to enhance the player experience and reflect the game's quirky, challenging spirit. The goal was to create a visual language that feels both playful and intuitive, supporting the gameplay without ever getting in the way. Download on Itch.io

portfolio.title: Sci-Fi Door System
portfolio.description: In my recent project, I focused on interactive design principles to create engaging buttons for a number guessing game. By using a pastel purple color palette and microinteractions, I aimed to enhance the user experience and increase user engagement. These buttons, through a captivating interactive experience, contribute to increased user enjoyment of the game.

portfolio.title: Tower Jump - Hyper Casual Game Template
portfolio.description: This playful button was part of a custom nail appointment site. A tiny polish bottle tilts and "paints" the button when clicked—mimicking the nail service being booked. It's a fun, elegant touch that connects the digital interaction to the real-world experience. Download on Unity Asset Store

portfolio.title: Water Simulation with Proximity Experiment
portfolio.description: A fun experiment in Unity, aiming to replicate Blender's Geometry Nodes for procedural water simulation. Implemented proximity-based interactions to dynamically influence water movement, creating a fluid and adaptive simulation.

portfolio.title: Interactive Portfolio Skills
portfolio.description: In my portfolio, the Skills section is interactive and alive. Clicking on a skill opens a page with detailed insights, making the experience memorable and informative. This blend of motion, learning, and engagement brings the section to life.
